## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-01-27: S-1/A files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2.
- 2021-02-10: Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated February 10, 2021 between Bumble Inc. and the TRA Parties (Blackstone-affiliated funds, Founder Whitney Wolfe Herd, and other pre-IPO owners).
- 2021-02-16: 8-K reporting IPO close files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

#### Negotiated termination

- 2025-11-05: Amendment No. 1 to the TRA executed under Section 7.6(b); adds a fixed Settlement Payment Schedule to Section 4.1(a) substituting for the Early Termination Payment formula. Concurrent with Blackstone's exchange of all 16.6 million Common Units for Class A shares immediately before the amendment. 8-K Item 1.01 and Item 1.02 report entry into and termination of the material agreement.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Bumble Inc.'s February 10, 2021 Up-C IPO and obligated Bumble to pay 85% of realized U.S. tax benefits to Blackstone-affiliated funds, the Founder, and other pre-IPO owners on IPO Basis, Blocker Transferred Basis, Pre-Merger NOLs, and Section 754 step-ups from future exchanges. On November 5, 2025, an Independent Special Committee negotiated an Amendment No. 1 that added a fixed Settlement Payment Schedule substituting for the Section 4.1 Early Termination Payment formula; the amendment was concurrent with Blackstone's exchange of all 16.6 million Common Units for Class A shares immediately beforehand. The gross settlement was approximately $186.0M ($185.7M cash paid), more than a 50% discount to the $416.7M TRA carrying value at December 31, 2024; the $241.6M excess of liability over cash distribution was recorded in additional paid-in capital and the related deferred tax assets were reversed. See `contract_log.md` for the termination-via-amendment analysis.
